sentences.text:
By this application under Section 438, Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 Page No.# 2/3 [CrPC],
the petitioner viz. Sri Praveen Kumar Jain has approached this Court seeking the benefit of pre-arrest bail, apprehending his arrest, in connection with Bharalumukh Police Station Case no.
313/2023, registered for offences punishable under Sections 420/34, Indian Penal Code [IPC] read with Section 63 of the Copyright Act, 1957.

3. In the First Information Report [FIR], the informant who has stated himself to be a Power of Attorney holder of various companies like Hewlett- Packard, Canon, Samsung, etc., has inter alia alleged that the persons named in the FIR who are associated with a business entity, M/s Komal Infotech have been selling counterfeit products of those companies in violation of trademarks/copyright and in the process, cheated the manufacturers as well as the general public.

4. The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is the proprietor of M/s Komal Infotech and M/s Komal Infotech is an authorized retailer of a number of companies like Canon, Acer, Samsung, etc. it is asserted that the petitioner is dealing only with such products.
It is submitted that the allegations leveled in the FIR have no basis.

5. List the case on 23.11.2023 to enable the learned Additional Public Prosecutor to produce the concerned case diary.
6.

The petitioner shall not directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer; and 3.
The petitioner shall not hamper with the investigation or tamper with the evidence of the case.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Having regard to the nature of allegations made in the FIR and the projections made above on behalf of the petitioner, it is provided, in the interim and till further consideration is made on the basis of the materials in the case diary to be produced, that in the event of arrest of the petitioner in connection with Bharalumukh Police Station Case no. 313/2023, he shall be released on bail Page No.# 3/3 on furnishing a bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- with one local surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority, subject to the conditions that :
1. The petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer of the case within a period of 10 [ten] days from today and shall cooperate with the investigation of the case;
2.
The petitioner shall not hamper with the investigation or tamper with the evidence of the case.
